This small coffee shop might be easy to miss if you aren't paying attention. It's small, cozy and clean once inside. After looking over the menu I decided on the Iced Black Tonic and Mint. The drink was refreshing, bold, smooth and just a hint of mint and citrus to keep my attention. Very enjoyable! The CR was clean, but no WiFi.

We visited Blank Space Coffee on a Sunday morning and appreciated the ample parking space. The cafe itself is quite small and intentionally dark, likely in keeping with its moody, minimalist theme. While this may appeal to those who enjoy a more introspective setting, it might feel a bit enclosed for others. We tried the dirty matcha, matcha latte V2, and a revel bar. At first sip, the matcha flavor was subtle, but it gradually developed into a more pronounced and well-balanced taste, bold yet not overpowering. I did find that I enjoyed the drinks more after asking for extra ice. The dirty matcha had a pleasant coffee kick that was smooth and didn't cause any stomach discomfort, which I personally appreciated. It struck a nice balance between being robust but not too acidic. That said, considering the portion size, I found the drinks slightly on the pricier side relative to the usual rates in Davao's coffee and matcha scene. The revel bar was a standout. It was generously sized for ₱100, moist, and not overly sweet. It felt like good value for money and complemented the drinks well. One downside during our visit was when we asked for a sales invoice and were told none could be provided. As a business, especially one that charges relatively premium prices, having proper documentation like a sales invoice is important and expected, so that was a bit of a letdown. Another thing to note is that they do not provide service water; instead, bottled water is offered at ₱20 per bottle. As for service, the two staff members on duty during our visit seemed a bit reserved and disengaged. While service was still efficient, a warmer interaction would definitely elevate the overall customer experience.
The place is small, quiet, and has limited seating. The size of the drink didn't quite match the price. I'd rate their matcha a 7/10 — good, but there's room for improvement.
